summary: Rafael Henríquez is 19 and in his third semester of Tamsen Valley College's automotive technology program. He lives with his parents Oscar and Gladys and works the family's Pupusería Henríquez stand Thursday through Sunday. He can hear a bad injector across a parking lot, but written multiple-choice tests make him freeze, and the ASE G1 practice exam he needs for a shop internship is looming in November. He wants his own repair shop someday. Even picturing it makes him feel guilty, because the stand needs him, especially once it moves from the Delgado Park market to a permanent Ruel Road lot in October. He is also the family's driver, ferrying his cousin Dulce home from Taquería Colima and running errands in his aging 2009 Tacoma. His girlfriend Ximena pushes him to dream bigger, and his classmate Dante keeps pitching a car-flipping side hustle that tempts him.

impressions.statement: Understands things by doing them and gets stuck when he has to read them

impressions.statement: Freezes up and doubts himself on timed written tests, even when he knows the material

impressions.changed_to: Still nervous before tests but starts trusting the study system that raised his score
